label: Figure 8.5: A specific subsidy of $4,000 per home solar system
alt: Supply curve S and a parallel curve S minus subsidy lying $4,000 lower at every quantity, with two downward arrows.
caption: A specific subsidy of $4,000 per home solar system lowers the cost of supplying each system by the same amount, so the supply curve shifts vertically down by $4,000 at every quantity, from S to S − subsidy. It is the mirror image of a specific tax.
